title: Yoisaki Kanade — Clothes That Catch My Eye?〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Fleur Libre Pop-Up Store

rows.Speaker: Female Customer
rows.Line: Um, thank you for everything.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Of course. I hope you come back again.
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: She had such a big smile on her face.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Now it's our turn to have fun and pick out clothes♪

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Don't give me that, Kanade!
That's why we're here, remember?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: The fitting rooms are open, so please feel free to try on anything that catches your fancy.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wait, are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: All of the clothes here are imbued with the designers' special feelings, aren't they?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Shouldn't they be worn by people who like cute things and actually want to try them on...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Thank you for being so considerate of us, and of our clothes.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: But you never know until you try, I think.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Of course, you don't have to if you don't feel comfortable. But since we have the chance, I would like to see you try some things on.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But how should I even choose...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: In that case, Kanade, just take a quick look around and try on the first thing that catches your eye!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
The first thing that catches my eye?
That could work...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Why don't you try doing the same, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: If you have trouble choosing, then I can give you some recommendations.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (The first thing that catches my eye...)
se_walk_women_002_2

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (All of these clothes are so strange, unique and interesting...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But none of them have really caught my attention...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hm? What's this...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Is this a ribbon covered in flowers and lace? But it looks wide for a ribbon.
se_walk_women_002_4

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, Kanade, nice find!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? What is this?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, that headdress is so cute!
Great pick, Kanade! You've got good taste.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
It's a headdress...?
It goes on top of my head?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
But I was just wondering what it was.
I didn't really choose it per se...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? Where'd Ena and Mizuki go?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Probably to look for clothes that go with that headdress.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Look, they're coming back.
se_run_women_002_1
se_run_women_002_2

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Kanade! This should go perfectly with that headdress!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I also brought something that should go well with it! See these flowers around the bust? They should really match!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Please, you two, I just...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Which should we have her try on first?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hmm... You got back first, Mizuki, so I wouldn't mind giving you first dibs.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Really?
Oh, Kanade, do you have a preference?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Umm... Both seem fine...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Then, we'll have you try on what I found first! Here, check it out!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh... O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Are you really going to wear that?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: They did take the time to choose these for me.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I can't make heads or tails of this outfit.
se_walk_women_002_3

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: That's a set consisting of a blouse and dress. Let me take them off the hanger for you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, Sis, did the same person design the headdress Kanade found and this outfit I picked out?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Hehe. That's right!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: How did you know, Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hehe. It just hit me!
They're both frilly and flowery, but they still feel refined at the same time.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: The person that designed this is a senior of mine who helps me out a lot at work.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: If I recall, the idea here was to give people who aren't that fashion-conscious a nice set they can wear casually.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, Kanade, you fit that bill perfectly.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I suppose I do.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It's clear that the people who made all these clothes put quite a lot into them.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (And Yuki said sometimes, you don't know until you try...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I'll go try this on now.
I'll need a minute.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay, we're willing to wait as long as you need!
